policy.full_text: Full texts are fetched into .cache/corpus. Public-domain text witnesses (works with rights public_domain_text) are also committed, byte-identical to their pinned source, under corpus/texts via Git LFS; modern texts are never committed. Committed records carry short excerpts with edition-qualified locators.
